Verify someone's employment

For banks, landlords and background-check firms. No Remote account needed.

Before you start: we never confirm or deny an employment without that person's own permission, and we will follow up using the contact you give us. Every submission gets the same reply, whatever we find — so this page can never tell you whether a request is pending, was declined, or names nobody we know.

Quick-fill an example

They will find it in their Remote profile, under Job and Pay. We cannot look someone up by name alone.

Only ever used for the same note everyone gets.

We check what you were told against the record, rather than looking anyone up.

We never ask for a national ID number — no Social Security, BSN, NIF or National Insurance number. Neither does the standard US mortgage form, which asks for the employee number instead. In Europe it is not merely unnecessary: the Dutch government tells tenants to cover their BSN before handing over a payslip, and French law forbids a landlord from asking for a social-security card at all.
